content.short: Entropy Advisors is an onchain research and strategy firm, known for its work with the Arbitrum DAO.
content.description: Entropy Advisors turns on-chain data into strategy work for protocols and DAOs, combining proprietary data, incentive program design and active capital allocation. Its best-known engagement is a long-running embedded role in the Arbitrum ecosystem, where it works as an internal team in place of an outside consultancy. The practice covers three areas: data intelligence, market-aligned execution, and capital allocation with risk monitoring. Incentives distributed, capital strategies deployed and dashboards launched are its headline measures. It is engaged per mandate, not per seat.
